entry.name: rnbo_cycle~
entry.description: Generate a periodic waveform. The default waveform is one cycle of a cosine wave, but can be set to reference a named buffer.

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.description: Depending on the index mode this is the frequency (in Hz) or the phase (0. - 1.).

arguments.name: buffername
arguments.digest: buffer to read the wavetable from (default: sinus)
arguments.description: The buffername attribute followed by the name of a valid buffer will fill the cycle~ wavetable with the values from that buffer instead of the default wavetable.
